recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: infra tooling ships another quiet dot-release for operators
Newton's pull measured again against stranger cosmic scales
cool spring clarity, ten degrees under a glass-clear bay sky
May light stretching toward long evenings
probability boards flicker while spring waits outside the window

composer-2-fast.concept: Tiny ops daemon rerouting packet-fireflies between blooming nodes before a deploy countdown finishes.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Lane switch plus tap-to-prioritize queues as traffic forks.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Swipe between lanes; tap to bump priority.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Clearing one wave without a spill feels like a green deploy.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Extra protocols spawn mid-wave and lanes jitter faster.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon terminal vines with blossom glyphs

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Conduct a pendulum choir—masses swing through harmonic gates that only open on an invisible stutter-house pulse.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Hold/release timing so swings thread narrow listening windows.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Hold to charge swing, release through the gate slit.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Each clean passage stacks another airy vocal layer.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Gates shrink and tempo drift misaligns neighboring pendulums.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Matte black void, chrome weights, thin laser thresholds

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Flick stranded synth shards into nested orbit shells until each hue completes its ring.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Physics flick sorting with decaying angular momentum.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Flick outward from center to sling shards into matching shells.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Satisfying magnetic snap when a shell locks full.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Gravity wells multiply and shards gain noisy spin.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Dream-pop aurora gradients over deep navy space

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Trace one continuous fiber thread across a foggy ridge silhouette without crossing rising noise spikes.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Single-stroke path drawing with collision forgiveness shrinking each segment.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Drag to draw; lift breaks the line and fails the attempt.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Completing the route floods the bay with diluted sunrise.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Noise serpents chase proximity to your trail and spike density climbs.
